# Branch Efficiency and Customer Wait Time Management

This document addresses key operational areas requiring immediate attention:

*   Optimization and update of branch efficiency standards.
*   Review and update of customer wait times based on audit findings.
*   Quarterly updates for customer wait times.
*   Continuous monitoring of branch efficiency based on audit recommendations.
